Senses.Explanation: Great capacity and great function names responsive capacity together with that capacity in full operation; the records can divide the pair for comparison and reunite it as one compound. Huangbo Xiyun states that he saw Mazu’s great capacity and great function. Tianyin Yuanxiu separately asks about the compound and its two coordinated members, then elsewhere says the pair is not located on a sitting mat or Chan board. Yulin Tongxiu warns against mistaking coarse abandon for the pair; Guting Shanjian and Poshan Haiming describe its inexhaustibility and whole-body operation. These comparisons concern one coordinated device.
